verses.1: These were the sons of David who were born to him in Hebron: The firstborn was Amnon by Ahinoam of Jezreel; the second was Daniel by Abigail of Carmel;
verses.2: the third was Absalom the son of Maacah daughter of King Talmai of Geshur; the fourth was Adonijah the son of Haggith;
verses.3: the fifth was Shephatiah by Abital; and the sixth was Ithream by his wife Eglah.
verses.4: These six sons were born to David in Hebron, where he reigned seven years and six months. And David reigned in Jerusalem thirty-three years.
verses.5: These sons were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon. These four were by Bathshua daughter of Ammiel.
verses.6: David’s other sons were Ibhar, Elishua, Eliphelet,
verses.8: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet—nine in all.
verses.9: These were all the sons of David, besides the sons by his concubines. And Tamar was their sister.
verses.10: Solomon’s son was Rehoboam: Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
verses.11: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
verses.12: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
verses.13: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
verses.14: Amon his son, and Josiah his son.
verses.15: The sons of Josiah: Johanan the firstborn, Jehoiakim the second, Zedekiah the third, and Shallum the fourth.
verses.16: The successors of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, and Zedekiah.
verses.17: The descendants of Jeconiah the captive: Shealtiel his son,
verses.18: Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
verses.19: The sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel and Shimei. The children of Zerubbabel: Meshullam and Hananiah, and their sister Shelomith,
verses.20: and five others: Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushab-hesed.
verses.21: The descendants of Hananiah: Pelatiah and Jeshaiah; the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, and the sons of Shecaniah.
verses.22: The descendants of Shecaniah: Shemaiah and his sons: Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat—six in all.
verses.23: The sons of Neariah: Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam—three in all.
verses.24: The sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani—seven in all.
